$schema_comment: Default application configuration for Knowledge Discovery Sandbox Demo. Loaded at startup; UI overrides persist in localStorage.
$upstreamHost_comment: Backend ACI host used by the dev proxy (proxy.conf.mjs) and to derive viewUpstreamOrigin / endpoint-health.json testUrls. Edit this to change the backend IP without touching upstream.config.mjs. Overridden per-run by the KD_UPSTREAM_HOST env var if set. Takes effect on the next `npm start` / `serve.sh` (they run sync-config.sh -> generate-config.mjs first).

components.label: Community
components.$statusPort_comment: Optional. GetStatus is a service action, not an ACI action — IDOL requires it be sent to the component's Service port, which is often a different port than the ACI port above (9033) that normal Community calls and the a=admin browser UI use. Leave null to keep testing the same port as 'upstream'. Find the real value in the Community .cfg file's [Service] ServicePort= setting, or on the Overview/Status page inside a=admin, then set it here (a plain number, e.g. 9034) and re-run npm start / serve.sh to pick it up.

components.label: Content
components.description: Search / Query against the Content engine.

components.label: Content Index
components.description: Index port — DRECREATEDBASE and other DRE* admin calls (not the ACI query port).

components.label: View Upstream Origin
components.description: Absolute origin for nested View iframe rewrites (xECM).
components.$absoluteDefault_comment: Left empty on purpose. Runtime and generate-config.mjs compose https://{upstreamHost}:{port from upstream}. Do not hardcode an IP here.

components.label: Gateway origin
components.description: SPA + reverse-proxy origin. Leave blank to use the current page origin.

components.label: NiFi canvas
components.description: Apache NiFi canvas UI. Independent of IDOL services — excluded from Apply to All.
